title_en: 2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Program: Applications Due 28 October
summary: Currently enrolled second- to fourth-year undergraduates in the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering who wish to join the 2026 Undergraduate Research Internship may apply. Applicants must complete Form 1 (application and recommendation) and the Attachment 3 candidate list and email them to the department office by 17:00 on Wednesday, 28 October 2026; the email address is in the original notice. The internship runs during the winter vacation, from 15 December 2026 to 8 February 2027, and two students will be selected.
applies_to: Voluntary; open to applicants who meet all of the following: currently enrolled undergraduates in the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering in years 2 to 4; able to participate for at least 10 hours per week; able to complete the regular Safety and Environment Training in Fall 2026; and enrolled with no change in academic status during Fall 2026 and the internship period. Third- and fourth-year students are given priority in selection.

translation:
2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Program: Application Notice (until Wednesday, 28 October)

Continuing from 2025, the College of Engineering, Seoul National University, announces the 2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Program to give undergraduate students hands-on experience of real research settings. Interested undergraduates are encouraged to apply as described below.

A. Overview
1) Through the program, the College provides research-based experience that complements the regular curriculum, so that students can experience a graduate-level research environment in advance and clarify their career paths.
2) By giving undergraduates experience of real research settings, the program supports research interest and career exploration and develops creative problem-solving skills and research capability early.

B. Details
1) Number selected in the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering: 2 currently enrolled undergraduates
2) Internship period: (during vacation) Tuesday, 15 December 2026 to Monday, 8 February 2027, 8 weeks
3) Internship stipend: KRW 400,000 per student × 2 months (KRW 800,000)
4) Eligibility: currently enrolled students in years 2 to 4 of the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering who
- can participate for at least 10 hours per week;
- can complete the regular Safety and Environment Training in Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기);
- are enrolled with no change in academic status during Fall 2026 and the internship period.
※ Students can check their own training record through the Research Safety Integrated Information System (SAFE).

C. How to apply and selection criteria
- Deadline and method: Complete [Form 1] Undergraduate Research Internship Application and Recommendation [학부생 연구인턴십 지원신청 및 추천서] and [Attachment 3] Department Candidate List, and send them by email to the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering office by 17:00 on Wednesday, 28 October 2026. (The email address is given in the original notice.)
※ Observe the deadline strictly, and read the support plan in [Attachment 1] carefully for details before applying.
- Selection criteria:
1) Third- and fourth-year students of the department are selected first (with reference to plans to enter the department's graduate school and to multiple-major study).
2) Applicants are ranked by a score calculated as major credits completed in the department × overall GPA.
(If applicants have equal rank, a department meeting decides, considering each laboratory's current interns, and assigns priority to laboratories of newly appointed faculty.)

D. Requirements for participants
- Participants join research only after sufficient training on research activities (precautions during experiments, how to use equipment, etc.) has been given.
- Participants write a result report using [Form 2] (contents: summary of research participation, tasks performed, expected outcomes, etc.) and submit it once a month.
- Participants record their research activity regularly using [Form 3] Undergraduate Research Intern Attendance Log.

Attachments
1. 2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Pilot Program Support Plan (College of Engineering), 1 copy
2. Attachment 2: 2026 College of Engineering Undergraduate Research Internship Application Guide, 1 copy
3. Attachment 3: Undergraduate Research Internship Candidate List, 1 copy
4. Attachment 5: Forms and regulations on Safety and Environment Training completion, 1 copy

Attached files (4):
Attachment 1. 2026 College of Engineering Undergraduate Research Internship Program Support Plan (1).hwp (176 KB)
Attachment 2. (Guide for undergraduates) 2026 College of Engineering Undergraduate Research Internship Application Guide (1).hwp (161 KB)
Attachment 3. 2026 College of Engineering Undergraduate Research Internship Applicant List (Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering) (1).xlsx (14 KB)
Attachment 5. Forms and regulations on Safety and Environment Training completion.zip (565 KB)

(Translator's note: The attached files, including Forms 1 to 3, were not read; their contents are not reflected here. The notice does not list Forms 1 to 3 as separate files.)
